messages:
julia_solutions: Hey team — we have an enterprise demo on 2026-04-02. Customer load tests show ~180 qps sustained for a 2hr window, peaking at ~240 qps. We're on Hosted using a scoped key. Can we get a temporary rate bump to 250 qps and a 100k token/day cap for 2 days? Need CORS origin allowlist and scoped key permission. @ops-oncall @eng-runtime
alan_se: +1 urgent. This demo unlocks the deal. Can you share ETA and any constraints (latency hit, model fallbacks)?
sara_sales: I'll pull the exact traffic shape and customer domains. Do we want a single scoped key or per-environment keys for the demo? @eng-runtime
eng-runtime: Scoped key is fine. Two quick questions: (1) which model(s) will they hit? (2) is traffic steady or spiky? We can enable a temp QPS increase and configure automatic fallback to a lighter model if queueing > 500ms. Also suggest enabling prefix caching for repeated prompts.
ops-oncall: Starting the escalation flow. Prefer per-customer scoped key with Origin locked. Who will own the key name?
security_bot: Quick checklist: any PII in the test requests/responses? Are logs forwarded to third-party sinks? Need confirmation for retention policy before we raise quotas.
julia_solutions: No PII — synthetic data only. Logs will remain on-platform with default 7d retention and no external sinks. We'll use a per-customer scoped key named scoped-key-customerX.
infra_ops_bot: Ticket created: INC-4721. Payload submitted for provisioning:
{
  "scope": "scoped-key-customerX",
  "qps": 250,
  "token_quota": 100000,
  "duration": "2026-04-02T09:00Z to 2026-04-03T09:00Z"
}
ops-oncall: Temporary change applied to scoped-key-customerX. Parameters: qps=250, token_budget=100k/day, origin-allowlist=https://customer-demo.example, expires=2026-04-03T09:00Z. Please test with the snippet below and report any 429s with X-Request-ID.
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer scoped-key-customerX" \
  -H "Origin: https://customer-demo.example" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.1-arch","input":"test"}'
```
eng-runtime: If you see 429s include X-Request-ID and approximate qps at the time. We can also configure an automatic fallback route to redwood-1.1-small to keep latency low. Consider reducing temperature or max_tokens for the demo to preserve the token budget.
alan_se: Awesome — forwarding to the customer now. How long until the change expires?
ops-oncall: Auto-revoke scheduled for 2026-04-03T09:00Z. If you need an extension, reply here and include updated traffic numbers; we can extend manually. Ticket INC-4721 marked 'provisioned' :white_check_mark:.
sara_sales: Thanks all — I'll run the smoke test and confirm by EOD. :thumbsup:
